message: The emulation check had no failed tests. It stopped early instead: it never ran because eight components (App ID, the two Code Engine apps, Elasticsearch, watsonx.ai and the three existing systems) don't have a typed IBM implementation or an import plan yet. That's not a mistake in your design, and changing the diagram can't fix it. Building IBM support for those parts is product engineering work, and this report on artifact 3a368f33 can serve as the repro. The only IBM contract we support today is private Object Storage, so I've left the design as it is rather than shrinking it down to storage. Before anyone starts that engineering work, which country do the customer and ticket data have to stay in?
